label: Rerun Job
mcp_tool_description: Rerun a finished CloudBolt job, exactly like the Rerun button on its job page (the v3 jobs clone endpoint): the new job reuses the old job's parameters, resource, servers and arguments and runs the current plug-in code. Give the job's global id (JOB-...) or numeric id. Use it to rerun a failed blueprint build item (a plug-in job) on the existing resource after syncing a fix, instead of tearing down and ordering again. It refuses a job that is still active, one already rerun (it names the latest rerun), and any job CloudBolt's own rerun rule refuses: non-admins can rerun only failed jobs; admins can also rerun successful plug-in, provision, blueprint and decommission jobs. Returns newJobId to poll with fetch_job_log. The caller needs CloudBolt's job.rerun permission on the job (admins and the job's owner have it).
